Definition: Understandability refers to how easily developers can comprehend and maintain the test code.

Task: Improve the understandability of the test `TestHalf.java` (path:- /Users/tenghaha/Projects/New_Agent_understandability_improvement/local_workplace/threeten-extra/src/test/java/org/threeten/extra/TestHalf.java). The refactored code must be syntactically correct and compilable against the provided CUT signatures. Do not alter the runtime behaviour of the original test: the same methods must be called with the same arguments and produce the same expected outcomes.

I'll read both the CUT and the original test file to understand the code before improving it.Now I have a clear picture of both files. Let me write the improved test with better understandability: replacing `assertEquals(false/true/null, ...)` with `assertFalse`/`assertTrue`/`assertNull`, fixing a method name typo, splitting the large `test_isSupported` into two focused tests, and adding missing import for `assertFalse`/`assertNull`.Now I'll compile-check the generated test.The improved test compiled successfully. The changes made were: replaced `assertEquals(false, ...)` with `assertFalse(...)`, `assertEquals(null, ...)` with `assertNull(...)`, split the monolithic `test_isSupported` into two focused tests (`test_isSupported_unsupportedFields` and `test_isSupported_halfOfYear`), and fixed the method name typo `test_from_TemporalAccessorl_invalid_noDerive` → `test_from_TemporalAccessor_invalid_noDerive`.
